//WeaponContent: Structural weapon metadata the preparation system needs, plus the combat metadata the
weapon registry names, kept out of API and UI code.
'Type' must be a weapon type the canonical registry names
cost: every Unit has exactly two weapon slots, and a weapon consumes 1 or 2 of them.
Only weapons the game can actually produce are listed. A weapon type with no entry here
cannot be equipped, and that is deliberate: the registry leaves slot cost for most types
as authored data, and guessing one would invent canon. Add the entry when the weapon
'Range' follows the registry's v1 defaults: 1 hex for an ordinary melee weapon and 3 for
the Ranged Weapons family. A Unit's reach is its weapon's, never its display name's.
TEMPORARY PROTOTYPE VALUES, NOT CANON: 'Power', 'CriticalChance' and 'Weight'. The
registry says weapon Power should start low and leaves the exact budgets and the
Light/Medium/Heavy assignment per weapon type as balance work.
